title: Measuring South Asian Biases in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a South Asian-specific bias lexicon targeting cultural stigmas related to purdah and patriarchy, and calculating Bias TF-IDF scores on open-ended LLM generations across 10 Indo-Aryan and Dravidian languages.
Generating open-ended text (stories, hobbies, to-do lists) for male and female identities and scoring the frequency of biased terms using a culturally-grounded bias lexicon and Bias TF-IDF metric.
Generating open-ended text for Hindu and Muslim identities across multiple languages and evaluating the outputs using a custom bias lexicon and TF-IDF scoring.
Generating open-ended text for single, married, divorced, and widowed identities and measuring the prominence of biased or stigmatizing terms using a lexicon-based TF-IDF score.
Evaluating open-ended text generation for identities with varying numbers of children (none, one, many) to measure childbearing stigmas using a custom bias lexicon and TF-IDF metric.
